args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring specifying
banker's rounding, causing tests/test_money.py to fail (e.g. 2.665
expected 2.66, got 2.67). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match FIN-212.

args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was actually using `ROUND_HALF_UP` — despite the docstring claiming otherwise.

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: switch `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, e.g. `2.665` now rounds to `2.66` instead of `2.67`.

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed** (fixes the failing `tests/test_money.py`).

Fixes the FIN-212 compliance gap. Reviewer: @alex
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
